ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To help more users achieve steady growth through Copy Trading, the “Copy Trading Advancement Program” is back. With tiered task designs and three progressively unlocked challenges, complete the tasks to receive exclusive rewards. Share a limited-time prize pool of 200,000 USDT—this event will support your advancement every step of the way.
Join Now

Meet the required amount for a single copy trade and generate a copy trade to claim tiered rewards.
Single Copy Trade Amount (USDT) | Reward Amount (USDT) | Number of Rewards (Units)
≥ 200 | 100 | 500

Follow 3 different lead traders and complete valid copy trades to receive a reward of 100 USDT. The event prize pool is 5,000 USDT, available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Participants must click the 【Join Now】 button on this event page to register. Failure to register indicates that the participant is not eligible to participate.

Headline: Onchain trading challenge round 136 (SOL)—register and trade to share 50,000 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Bitget Onchain trading challenge round 136 (SOL edition) is now live! Trade any coin on the SOL chain during the promotion to unlock Mystery Boxes. Every Mystery Box contains a crypto voucher worth up to 100 USDT. There are more rewards to share, too: exclusive new-user rewards, trading check-in rewards, and guaranteed trading rewards.
Promotion period: November 24, 2026, 2:00 PM – December 1, 2026, 12:00 AM (UTC+8)
Eligible coins: all SOL-chain coins
Join Now
## 1. Register to get rewards
During the promotion period, users who sign up will receive a 5 USDT fee rebate voucher, issued after the promotion ends.
## 2. Trade to open Mystery Boxes
During the promotion, every Mystery Box giveaway comes with a USDT crypto voucher worth up to 100 USDT. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis until they run out.
Daily total trading volume (USDT) | Daily total giveaway chances
50 | 1
100 | 2
## 3. Trade daily to get rewards
During the promotion period, users who reach the required total trading volume each day (UTC+8) will receive the corresponding reward. Daily rewards cannot be claimed more than once, and each user can receive only one reward tier per day.
Reward tier | Daily total trading volume (USDT) | Guaranteed daily reward
Tier 1 | 100 | 1 USDT fee rebate voucher
Tier 2 | 500 | 1 USDT
Tier 3 | 1000 | 2.5 USDT
Tier 4 | 2000 | 6 USDT
## 4. Reach trading volume milestones to get guaranteed rewards
During the promotion period, users who sign up and reach the required total trading volume for designated coins will receive the corresponding guaranteed rewards.
Trading volume requirement | Guaranteed reward (USDT)
200,000 | 600
150,000 | 440
100,000 | 280
70,000 | 190
30,000 | 80
10,000 | 25
## 5. Promotion notes
Users must select "
Join now
" to register before they can participate in the promotion. Only Onchain trading orders placed after successful registration will be counted.
Mystery Box rewards are issued instantly when each box is opened. New-user rewards and trading leaderboard rewards will be distributed within seven working days after the promotion ends.
Users who have completed Onchain trades before registering for the promotion will be considered existing users. Only orders placed after registration count toward the promotion.
Users are only eligible to receive the greater reward of the daily trading reward and the trading milestone reward.
If separate promotions are offered for new and existing users, new users making their first trade are eligible only for new-user rewards. They cannot receive existing-user rewards, even if they make additional trades during the promotion. However, if both a new-user promotion and an all-user promotion are available, new users who meet the eligibility requirements for both may receive rewards from both promotions.
Sub-accounts, institutional users, and market makers are not eligible for this promotion. API trading volume is also excluded from the calculations.
For Onchain signal copy trading, eligible orders are buy orders placed on the Onchain signals page and automated take-profit and stop-loss (TP/SL) orders that use Onchain signals. Copy orders can currently be placed only in the Bitget app.
PnL during the promotion = realized PnL during the promotion. ROI = total realized PnL ÷ total buy amount of the realized portion. Only users with positive PnL are eligible for ranking.
In the ending-number promotion, users have a 10% chance of receiving a reward. The ending numbers will be announced within one day after the promotion ends.
Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within seven working days after the promotion ends. Users can find their rewards in their Onchain account.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's Terms and Conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from participating in the promotion and confiscate their rewards if any fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim rewards), or other violations are found.
Bitget reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to change or revise the promotion terms or cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice.
Bitget reserves the right of final interpretation regarding this promotion. Contact our customer service if you have any questions.

1. There are several daily tasks during this promotion. Each completed task grants you one Mystery Box with guaranteed rewards.
2. Daily tasks refresh at 12:00 AM (UTC+8). Make sure to complete them within the day.
3. Mystery Box supply is limited and available while supplies last. Plan ahead and participate early to avoid missing out.
## 4. Daily tasks—trading volume tasks:
New CFD user task: Place your first CFD trade with a volume of over 4000 USDT to get three Mystery Boxes.
Daily task 1: Total CFD trading volume exceeding 50,000 USDT grants one Mystery Box.
Daily task 2: Total CFD trading volume exceeding 200,000 USDT grants one Mystery Box.
## Reward pool 2: Referral rewards
1. Existing Bitget CFD users can invite new users to sign up. Once a new user completes the designated CFD trading tasks, both the inviter and the invitee will receive rewards.
Task | Referral tasks | Inviter reward | Referral reward
Task 1 | Sign up on Bitget and reach a CFD trading volume of 10,000 USDT | 3 USDT | 3 USDT
Task 2 | Reach a total CFD trading volume of 200,000 USDT | 3 USDT | 3 USDT
2. Referrals who reach a total CFD trading volume of more than 300,000 USDT during the promotion period are eligible to share a 4000 USDT reward pool, with individual rewards capped at 50 USDT.
3. Inviters will be ranked based on the number of valid new users they successfully refer during the promotion period and can earn up to an additional 100 USDT in rewards.
Ranking | Rewards (USDT) | Minimum referrals required
1st–5th | 100 | 40
6th–20th | 60 | 25
21st–53rd | 20 | 10
## Reward pool 3: Trade daily to earn credits
1. Daily credits accumulation: Earn one credit whenever your daily CFD trading volume reaches a designated tier. You may earn multiple credits by reaching multiple tiers. For example, you can earn one credit by reaching a trading volume of 50,000 USDT in a single day, two credits for 100,000 USDT, three credits for 200,000 USDT, and so on. There's no cap on the number of credits you can earn daily.
2. The corresponding reward pool is 7600 USDT. Reward calculation for users who meet the credit requirement: My reward = my credits ÷ total eligible credits × reward pool.
3. Credit threshold: The credit threshold for this promotion will be announced within one day after the promotion ends.
## Reward pool 4: Championship leaderboard
1. During the promotion, the user ranked 1st by CFD trading volume will exclusively receive 4000 USDT, and the user ranked 2nd will exclusively receive 3000 USDT. The total pool is 47,400 USDT. The rankings and rewards are as follows.
2. Users must meet both the ranking and minimum trading volume requirements to qualify for the corresponding reward tier. If only one requirement is met, rewards will be distributed based on the lower qualifying tier.
Ranking | Individual reward (USDT) | Minimum trading volume (USDT)
1st | 4000 | 1,000,000,000
2nd | 3000 | 500,000,000
3rd | 2000 | 400,000,000
4th–6th | 1000 | 300,000,000
7th–10th | 600 | 200,000,000
11th–50th | 300 | 80,000,000
51st–100th | 200 | 50,000,000
101st–220th | 50 | 20,000,000
221st-470th | 20 | 8,000,000

1. Users must use the
Join Now button to register for the promotion. The promotion includes four reward pools, and users are eligible to win from different pools.
2. During the promotion, orders are tracked daily from 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM (UTC+8) for credit calculation. Credits are awarded based on the actual order execution date.
3. Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within five working days after the promotion ends. Users can check their rewards in their spot accounts.
4. This promotion is exclusive to regular users. Sub-accounts, institutional users, PRO accounts, and market makers are not eligible to participate.
5. All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from participating in the promotion and confiscate their rewards if any fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim rewards), or other violations are found.
6. Bitget will conduct a review of all users and promptly disqualify those who employ any technical means, including but not limited to electronic, robotic, repetitive, or automated methods, for the purpose of automated or repeated registration and participation, and invalidate their rewards across all their accounts.

This Black Friday, your deposit earns more. With our new Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus, you can deposit $1,000 in fiat, trade the way you normally would and get up to $100 in BTC. Rewards stack across four milestones, so the more you trade, the more you can unlock.
## How the Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus works
## Getting started takes three steps:
- Enroll first. Opt in through the Rewards Hub in the Kraken app. Deposits and trades made before you enroll don’t count toward any milestone.
- Deposit $1,000 in fiat. Fiat deposits only, made after you enroll and before the offer ends.
- Trade to unlock each milestone. Complete eligible Instant Buy trades to earn your way up to $100 in BTC.
The offer starts November 12 at 2:00 p.m. UTC (9:00 a.m. ET) and ends December 1 at 2:00 p.m. UTC, the day after Cyber Monday.
## Four stacked milestones, up to $100 in BTC
Each milestone adds to the last, and each one can be earned once. The maximum reward is $100 in BTC per client.
Milestone | What you do | Reward | Total reward so far
Milestone 1 | Deposit $1,000 in fiat and trade $1,000 | $10 in BTC | $10
Milestone 2 | Trade $2,500 in total | An extra $15 in BTC | $25
Milestone 3 | Trade $5,000 in total | An extra $25 in BTC | $50
Milestone 4 | Trade $10,000 in total | An extra $50 in BTC | $100
Each reward is a set dollar amount paid out in BTC. Three-quarters of the maximum reward sits at Milestones 3 and 4, so the biggest payouts go to the clients who trade the most.
## What counts toward the bonus
- Eligible trades: Instant Buy trades made after you enroll. Trades between fiat and stablecoins, or within stablecoins, don’t count. Trades of stocks, xStocks and Bundles don’t count either, and neither do derivatives and margin trades.
## A Black Friday example
## Here’s how the offer could play out from start to finish:
- November 12: You see the offer by email, push notification or an Explore card and enroll in the Rewards Hub.
- November 27 (Black Friday): You deposit $1,000 in fiat, then keep trading through Instant Buy until you reach $10,000 in total eligible trades. You’ve now completed all four milestones and earned $100 in BTC.
- Within 14 days of each milestone: Your BTC reward is paid out.
- December: You can trade or stake your BTC on Kraken while it’s held.
- January 1: Your BTC can be withdrawn.
## When you get paid and when you can withdraw
We pay each reward within 14 days of completing the milestone. Your BTC is held on Kraken until December 31, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. UTC and can be withdrawn from January 1, 2027. While it’s held, you can still trade it or stake it on Kraken.
Keep in mind that BTC rewards can go up or down in value.
## Who can participate
The Black Friday Deposit & Trade Bonus is available to eligible clients in:
- United States: 47 states and Washington D.C. (excluding Florida, Maine, and New York)
- European Economic Area and other eligible countries
The offer is not available in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Switzerland, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Turkey, Russia, Brazil, Puerto Rico or sanctioned regions. See the full terms and conditions for details.
## Enroll, deposit, trade
Enroll in the Rewards Hub first, deposit $1,000 in fiat and trade your way to up to $100 in BTC before the offer ends on December 1 at 2:00 p.m. UTC.
